title.narrative: Cauca Local Economic Development (CLED) Project: A Triple Helix+ Approach towards Inclusive and Conflict-Sensitive Development in Cauca

description.narrative:
The project has to contribute to the following impact and must achieve the outcomes and outputs as stated below.
Long-term impact: Social and economic reconstruction: Income generating and livelihoods opportunities to prevent the (re)occurrence of conflicts, instability or irregular migration.
Medium-term impact that will contribute to this: (I) education system (TVET/HE) is of good quality, relevant and accessible (SDG 4); (II) partnerships between persons and organisations are inclusive and sustainable (SDG 17); (III) organisations key to (sectoral) inclusive development of partner countries are strengthened by inflow of enhanced workforce.
Outcome at project level: A. TVET/HE organisations (in the selected partner countries and in NL) perform better their core tasks, firmly embedded in their environment (in line with country / regional specific labour market needs & aiming at inclusiveness);
To that end, the following output(s) must be achieved by the end of the project: 1. Developing and Implementing a Customised Triple Helix+ Model and Mapping. 2. Capacity Building of SENA, ESAP, FUP and CREPIC and Incubation/Roll Out.

comment.narrative:
11-05-2020: 2 curricula training approaches revised and 2 trainings.
As result of the mappings and studies during 2019 plans for 2020 have been developed. The crossing of these maps only was possible in February 2020 and from there the priorities are settled.

14-03-2022: Course in Conflict and Peace delivered by University Utrecht and Universidad de Medellin, called: Introduction to social and political studies of peace and conflict (1). Course in Quality Assurance and Accreditations, strategic approach for HEI, designed according to needs and assessment of FUP, delivered by MSM (1) Course in Triple Helix + with emphasis in value chains: coffee, fishery and tourism. The training in gender and in entrepreneurship are planned for 2021.

11-05-2020: Key Stakeholders representing FUP, SENA, ESAP and CREPIC have been discussing and working in the conditions required to make the Triple Helix construction successful. This is an ongoing goal.
A series of training in capacity building for innovation and applying participative methodologies started in November 2019. The group is conformed by representatives of the partners, the three municipalities part of this project, members of the organization of ex-FARC combats and coffee growers. This joined training was prioritized as a required strategy to gain trust and to start a sustainable collaboration.
female/male ratio higher than the that of the total employee ratio

14-03-2022: The training included Conflict and Peace (14), Triple Helix (18); Quality Assurance in HEI (8). We are not counting 24 participants who initiated the training in Participative rural innovation, because it was postponed to 2021 (due to the lockdown)
female/male ratio higher than the that of the total employee ratio

title.narrative: A.E.1. Number of (knowledge) institutions supported directly

comment.narrative: ### SENA. ESAP, CREPIC and FUP are directly supported by CLED project

11-05-2020: The partners have been collaborating and are committed to the project. After the first year the project “CLED” is recognized and its partners have become a reference for other donors and organizations working in Cauca.

14-03-2022: During the first project year all four institutions were benefiting from the project. The same four institutions have been actively participating in the trainings planned and in the other Project activities.
SENA, ESAP, CREPIC and FUP

title.narrative: A.R.2. Number of relevant publications (level, gender, inclusion)

comment.narrative: 11-05-2020: The report for the “Sustainable Peace Laboratory” pillar and for the “Entrepreneur Hub” were elaborated. Also the value chain analysis for coffee, fishery and tourism. The questionnaires for Triple Helix readiness were not finished.

14-03-2022: 3 agendas for the TH+ model (1 per value chain), 1 FUP Entrepreneurship Policy (this was not part of the initial proposal and was done by initiative of the coordinator of the project at FUP. Research paper by the researchers from Universidad de Medellin, based on the results of the mapping elaborated in 2019.

title.narrative: A.S.2. Number of MoUs or other types of collaboration agreements signed (education, private, public, surrounding community)

comment.narrative: Triple helix in Caldono
11-05-2020: There is no MOU in process for Caldono around the coffee production.

14-03-2022: During the lockdown it was not possible to reach the communities and to progress with this target. There are plans to establish agreements among coffee farmers and stakeholders in the value coffee chain. Also initiatives in the tourism value chain in which the local government from the municipality is actively involved. The common agendas set by the organizations during the Triple Helix training has made possible to find common ground and different topics with potential for specific agreements.
